verdict.rationale: Prompt/prefix caching is a fair axis for an LLM inference cloud like DeepInfra, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions caching repeated context, cached-token pricing, or cache-driven latency gains. The priority tier offers faster time-to-first-token and the flex tier offers discounts, but neither is caching. The docs also say to resend the full message history on every request, with no mention of reusing it.
